coverage_notes.summary: No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access change was established in the bounded recall window. Searches covered hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural emergency service loss, ambulance, air-medical, restorations/reopenings, territories, and general access-loss reporting. Stale, proposed, non-U.S., business-only, and duplicate items were excluded.
